notes.title: Update 0.7.24.25 - Backglass Lights & High Score Saves!
notes.notes:
A player's table high scores now get saved locally as sgHighScores.sav in the SaveGames folder.
Fixed "saving table" text lingering on screen after save when dialog is cancelled.
Added backglass indicator lights (ball in play, match, high score, player #, etc) that can be complete modified. See accompanying video for details.
Fixed score displays not showing player number in Edit Mode.
Fixed plunger impulse bug that caused ball to launch when barely touching the plunger tip.
Prevented deletion of backglass displays and the newly added backglass indicator lights.
Added buttons in Edit Mode to allow for reset of backglass displays or light positions and rotations in case bugging of these occurs due to older tables missing the required object transform information or otherwise misplaced.
Grabbers for backglass displays, lights etc now toggle on/off with all grabbers when pressing V in Edit Mode.
Fixed standard gates, which allowed balls to pass through at high velocities. Extremely high velocities may still do so.
Also made a few smaller fixes under the hood.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 5.3.7
notes.notes: This version is built in the latest version of Unreal Engine, 5.5.3, and includes a ton of changes, mostly under the hood. The Leaderboards have been temporarily removed as well as planview layout screenshots. The primary focus of the game is 1) performance and 2) making sure that all the basic pinball functionality is working as it should. Updates should be rolling out more often again. Thank you for your patience and support.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.4.7.10
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=oRBadMhFx-o;full][/previewyoutube]

New Features
Added moveable plunger component. One may be placed on the playfield and when placed will replace the default plunger. The plunger may be moved side to side along the edge of the playfield. 
You can change the color of the rubber plunger tip on the new plunger component.
Added easy Group Name copy/paste option. Select object with Group Name you want to copy, or type a new group name into the Group Name field (make sure to press TAB or ENTER to commit the text), and then press ALT+G to COPY the selected object's group name, then select the object you want to add to the group and press the G key to paste the new name. 

Hold the LEFT CTRL key to move all objects in a group together as one.

Improvements
Thumper power default changed to 5.
Default ball spawner kicker power defaulted to 2.
Updated in-game keyboard layouts.
Component colors now remain when changing certain variant types.
Fixed grabbers on post caps.
Fixed metal post version "hard rubber post" color change issue.
Improved scene transitions.
Improved spawned flipper default values.W
Fixed loading of GI light level in Edit Mode.
Organized a couple of Edit Mode tiles (top bar).
Fixed bulb colors not duplicating.
Fixed spawn rotation of slingshots and two-post stetchies. 
Changed mouse cursor to hardware cursor to improve performance.
Changed font size of "merge collection" and its dropdown (Edit Mode).
Turned decals off on wire gates.

In Edit Mode, use arrow keys to move selected object 1mm up, down, left or right. Hold the SHIFT key to move the object 10mm at a time in those directions.
To change lighting in Edit Mode you must now HOLD the ALT key while pressing the desired arrow key. Left/right adjusts room lights. Up/down adjusts playfield lighting.

Fixed lower playfield wood not showing when being spawned.
Fixed pf hole cutter collision when in lower pf mode.
Planview measurement markers now show only during planview snapshot capture.

Play Mode tutorial final DISMISS button now works as it should.

New feature: Merge Collection! This allows you to create tables with names prefixed with "co_" that act as component collections (including logic) that can be imported into the table you are currently editing. See accompanying video for more details.

notes.title: PinBuilder Update 0.4.5.20
notes.notes:
FPS now averages 120 on an I7-6850k with a 1080Ti and 24mb of RAM on ULTRA settings!

[previewyoutube=fUMS3MwPUh4;full][/previewyoutube]

New Features
Logic Controllers of the "Bonus Counter" type can have target and completion audio assigned which will be played during bonus counting (target) and at the end of each round of counting (completion). 
Logic Controllers of the "Bonus Multiplier" atype with a completion audio set will be play the audio after all multipliers are tallied.
Added FPS to Edit Mode HUD (visible when Show FPS is checked in Settings).
Added new illumination component to light apron instruction cards.
Custom ball shooters can now be set up. ***ADD MORE/FIX THIS***
Aprons can now be created using custom components. 
Added Main Menu dropdown list that shows all saved tables. Selecting a table here will open it. Cancel with ESC.
Added text filter for Objects List in Edit Mode.
Added new Logic Controller type: Timer Stop which stops any/all connected timers. Timers can be restarted again by simply triggering them via another controller.

Improvements
Updated gate rebound physics.
Major improvements to ball performance.
Nudge/bump has been improved.
Improved hole material for better visibility.
Improved plunger placement.
All timers and magnets are stopped at ball drain.
Removed Unreal Lumen rendering for massively improved rendering performance.
Changed game object tick type for dramatically improved performance and better timing.

Fixes
Bonus and Multiplier counters are now fixed.
Rail Spline fixed. Mesh had been inadvertently simplified, causing hard corners. Mesh is now more complex, allowing for smooth curves.
Removed setting of unsaved changes when selecting scale mode.
Fixed color changing issue with slingshots.
Fixed multiball spawn point arrow display issue.
Removed default "ding" sound from Logic Controller events.
Fixed some tool tips.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.4.4.24

New Features
Upper/lower dynamic playfield corners can now be snapped to one another for super-accurate edge and corner placement. Hold ALT to grab blue corner grabber, then also hold CTRL to snap to corners of other dynamic playfields.
Dynamic playfield plastics can now also be snapped in the same manner as described above.
Playfield bulbs and LEDs can now be controlled by Logic Controllers.
Playfield bulbs and LEDs now have collision with ball.

Improvements
Upgraded Unreal project to 5.3.2 for performance, lighting and material improvements.
Improved spawning of dynamic upper/lower playfield components. Their grabbers can be grabbed immediately without having to select the whole component first.
Default Plastics Decal vertical placement has been improved.
Attract mode lighting has been improved. Bright phase now utilizes a bulb's intial brightness value.
Improved playfield LED lighting quality.
Improved Shining room lighting and details.
Added hi-tech post version to the top lane divider component.
Made numerous improvements to Kaiju Battle.

Fixes
Fixed upright switch sizes.
Slingshot decals now reappear when changing slingshot solenoid power.
Removed unwanted collision on plastic decals (Edit Mode).
Fixed slingshot silicone color changing problem (some parts didn't change color).
Playfield glass offset and rotation  issue resolved.
Resolved issue with cab texture being erroneously lit inside standard cabinet.
Fixed resetting of random Logic Controller event not working correctly.
Fixed reversed flipper problems. For reversed flippers on lower pf, make sure Reversed checkbox is checked.
Fixed slingshot posts and rubber materials.
Fixed pf components with plastic posts that had material issues.
Removed unwanted collision of Logic Controllers when collapsed.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.4.4.4
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=VI2aJSHvGnI;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VI2aJSHvGnI[/previewyoutube]

New Features
Added new silicone rubber option for playfield components with rubber. Select it in the variant. We'll expand this to other plastics types soon.
Added a new room, Shining.
Added a new Logic Controller type, "Reset." This will reset all the controller's targets and if the targets are other Logic Controllers will reset their targets as well. 
Added magnet power option. Use carefully, settings over 8 may cause unexpected results!

Improvements
Reimplemented flipper tuner option and refined it. This is used to control flip speed (up), as a tweak for flipper english, and can be thought of as a flip speed modifier. Usage example: a low setting of .02 will cause the flipper to move upward very slowly. A setting of 22 will cause it to flip up to the full extent almost immediately. Choosing an appropriate setting will allow players to use flipper tap english to control the full flip extent of the flipper just as can be done with real flippers, allowing for shorter flipper strokes. This technique is helpful when passing the ball from one flipper to another, for example. Your existing flippers may need to be adjusted.
Improved lighting in Edit Mode. Transparent colors now look as they do in Play Mode.
Updated flipper power option.
Build sounds on/off setting now functions for all build sounds.

Fixes
Fixed unwanted collision when initially spawning inserts.
Fixed bug with sequential logic option, which was ignoring the first item after being reset.
Fixed Logic Controller CPU collapse/expand. CPUs now show the group name of collapsed controllers.
Fixed Logic Controller chip appearance delay.
Fixed outlines on Logic Controllers when they are selected.
Increased shininess of inserts.
Fixed right flipper rubber bounciness.
Fixed Diverter Wire logic control problem. They now work independently as they should.
Fixed metal ramp not spawning correct default (short, straight) mesh.
Removed rogue polygon in deflector plate (metal post variant).
Removed extra "l" in Ball Weight setting.

Notes
Magnet initial state must be set using a Logic Controller set to Fire At Start.
Shining bathroom model created by A9908244 on Sketchfab: https://sketchfab.com/A9908244

Added logic event types: Fire at game start (ball 1 for any player)

notes.notes:

Lower playfield hole and wood have been separated. Use the existing "Playfield Wood" with the Lower level option selected (upper-right dropdown). This enables holes in bottom playfields and separation of shape from the hole above.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.4.2.1 - Lower Playfields, Leaderboards & More!!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=sH6ORg7GNi8;full][/previewyoutube]

New Features
Added Show DMD Display option to Cabinet Mode panel. Shows/hides the DMD display on the backbox. 
Added color selector to Logic Mode to color new flow indicators. 
Logic Controllers have new 3D icons and new colorable flow indicating connectors. These will default to black and white but they can be changed the same way other objects are by using the color picker. NOTE: Logic Controllers that are not linked to other objects will remain white for easy indication on the playfield.
Added lower/under playfield option
Added playfield hole cutter component
Added Leaderboards for PB tables. We will add other tables, including user-created ones, in the future depending on build quality and popularity on Steam Workshop. PLEASE NOTE: The PB tables are not yet complete as our intent with them has been for players to update them on their own. In the coming weeks this will no longer be the case as we will finish the tables for use with the leaderboards. When all four tables are done, we will reset the leaderboards. You have been warned!
Kicker scoops can now be set to teleport ball to another location (ball spawners, see below).
Ball Spawner has new variant: "Teleport Location." Please see video for detailed information

Improvements
Flippers now have a new option: "is reversed." Use this for flippers that face backward such as those used in lower playfields. Please see update video for more details on setting up reversed flippers. 
Updated Logic Controller visuals.
Object movement now utilizes the object's existing Z coordinate and does not change the object's height. Object height must be set manually until we implement an object axis manipulator.
Added decimal precision to x, y, z coordinates in Edit Mode (lower left text inputs).
Scoop kicker hole functionality has been improved.
Standard kicker hole now shoots ball less vertically, which was causing issues in some circumstances.

Fixes
Fixed custom rail that wasn't working correctly in Play Mode.
Fixed Upper Playfield Wood default color (was grey, now white).
Fixed default spawn name for Ball Spawner.
Fixed Show All Connectors toggle, which wasn't hiding connectors.
Fixed ball teleporters to teleport only to ball spawners of the Teleport Location variant.
Fixed number indicators on playfield component icons in Edit Mode.
Removed empty upright switch variant.
Fixed metal texture on kicker hole deflection plate (variant of metal post).
Fixed selection mode cursor jumping bug.

notes.notes:

 Watch video for detailed information!

Added DMDs!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.12.26
notes.notes:
New Features
Added modifiable Z location to Edit Mode. To change height of an object, change this value and press enter. NOTE: 0 is the standard Z position for normal playfield height. 33 is the standard Z position for the upper playfield. You can enter any value you want. Also,we will be adding a standard object axis manipulator in a future update as well as the ability to change the height of the playfield itself, enabling very physically deep tables!
We added an Easter Egg to Edit Mode. See if you can find it!

Improvements
Lights and LEDs are now accessible via logic controllers in the same way that inserts are. NOTE: More logic for lighting soon to come!
Added grid to 2nd playfield level.
Duplication of habitrail variants fixed.
Slightly improved Edit Mode UI.
Updated the Quit Game dialog.

Fixes
Fixed problem with game starting in Cabinet Mode and not loading tables. We added a delay to initial load of Cab Mode menu to allow for game's initial table image copy routine to execute prior to the loading of table images in the menu. If no images load, hit ESC twice to reload the menu. If they still don't load, please make sure the game is version 0.3.12.26. If not, please let us know.

Fixed apron name default
Fixed grid fine-tuning offset

Added metal ramps (3 variations)
Added upper playfields
Added illuminated side blades. Please see cabinet art for Twisted Circus to see where to place art. We will upload a new template soon.
Added modifier to switch between upper/lower playfield movement modes (button or #4 on the keyboard)
Added keyboard controls for plunger: PgUp/PgDown to push/pull and Enter to release
Added new kicker option to kick balls straight up into "popper upper" habitrail component

Gameplay Improvements
Fixed flipper solenoid power adjustment action (was too weak)
Expanded range of flipper solenoid power slider
Changed default kicker power to 4

Misc
Reduced wood surround rebound amount 
Made tweaks to playfield wood
Fixed cabinet models for widebody and tall versions
Fixed misc plunger appearance issues
Minor behind-the-scenes tweaks

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.9.23 - Steam Workshop!!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that with this update comes access to the PinBuilder Steam Workshop! Along with this have been a few small changes here and there, including improvements to arcade lighting and more. Please check out this video for some quick info: [previewyoutube=ZMZ7IG9v58U;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

This update may also resolve a possible file install issue for some.

Please feel free to upload your tables to the PinBuilder Steam Workshop, but please make sure you share only complete tables which you feel others would enjoy playing or learning from.

Smaller Improvements
Improved spinner physics
Improved Main Menu UI design
Adjusted initial file copy routine
Removed blank playfield from My Tables
Added more tasks that trigger Unsaved Changes

You might notice a little tidbit we left in the build, the upper playfield wood component. You can add this to your playfields if you want. It will save, but it won't be of much use at this point. The Steam Workshop integration demanded all of our attention but barring any issues we're going to get back to working on the fun stuff. Believe us when we say, Steam Workshop integration is a massive pain in the!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.9.1
notes.notes:
UPDATE v0.3.9.1

Notes
HUGE UPDATE!

New Features

New table! Our version of Bally's Fathom, we call it Unfathomable. Please note: The table is unfinished and your mission is to finish it! 
Updated flippers to allow for proper skill shots using the flipper buttons for passing flipper-to-flipper etc with a new "flipper tuner" option to help dial in the right flipper feel
Added new thumper flash-on-hit option
Added new Live Test Mode. While in Play Mode, during a game, you can press U to show the mouse cursor which you can then use to click on targets, switches, etc to trigger them for easy logic testing.
Added new playfield blueprint layout snapshot option allowing for the export of playfield layouts for printing or use in producing real world playfields. NOTE: While this is available, it needs further tweaking to resolve a camera parallax issue, but we wanted you to be able to explore this option if you want.
Major update to PB file management system. User table files, images and sounds can now be grouped in their own folders under UserImages and UserSounds. Folder items and folders will be displayed automatically. NOTE: Files moved from one folder to another may need to be updated in Edit Mode.
Added new more realistic plastics type based on PNG images. NOTE: these do not have collision and balls will not roll on them and may get trapped under them behind posts, etc.
Added new ball reset hotkey. Press R to reset ball back into shooter lane. NOTE: Will move ALL active balls on the playfield to the shooter lane.
Edit Mode now saves last camera position and subsequently loads it.
Added transparent plastic variant to standard flippers.
Added transparent variant for plastic posts etc.
Added two new wire gate width variations. Now includes short, standard and wide versions.
Added lit short flippers
Added new playfield plastics to Alien Meadow
Added new panel for object text (moved from details panel)
Added lit spinner version
Added new spinner decal method. NOTE: ADD NOTE ABOUT THIS

Gameplay Improvements & Fixes

Improved auditioning of sounds in Logic and Cabinet modes. Click a "play" button one time to play a sound, click it again to stop the sound.
Fixed misc sound related issues
Improved Edit Mode color-changing options
Fixed default color buttons which were not setting some objects back to default colors
Wire gates require much less ball velocity to pass through
Wire gate rebound behavior improved
Improved playfield glass transparency
Improved Room and GI lighting. GI lighting now affects new playfield plastics.
Fixed brightness slider for insert lights
Found thumper image load bug in which loader was looking in wrong location for file even though filename was correctly showing in dropdown list.
Fixed logic controller switch type not firing its subsequent controller events
Fixed texture dropdown not enabling when plastics decal is selected
Fixed issue with Play Mode cam positions not saving during current game
Fixed drop target colors not updating as a group right after changing variant

Notes

Disabled UNDO. Will be redesigning and including this in a future update.
Files in the UserImages and UserSounds folders can now be organized in subfolders. Please see the 3.9.1 update video on our YouTube channel for more details about this.

notes.title: Update v0.3.7.21.2 - Flipper max hotfix
notes.notes: This update fixes an inversion issue with right flipper max range setting.

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.7.21.1 - Pop bumper texture hotfix
notes.notes: Just a quick fix for an issue incurred during the addition of the new drop target and spinner texture selection options. During that update the texture loading code for pop bumpers was disturbed.

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.7.21 - Drop target hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a few issues re the drop targets as well as took care of their misbehavior in Kaiju Battle and Alien Meadow.

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.7.19 - Custom spinner & drop target decals, balls per game and more!
notes.notes:
New Features

 Added changeable decals to drop targets and spinners. User images can be used for these now.
 Added balls per game. Can be set to any integer from 1-100. Found in Cabinet Settings.
 Added lit option to more objects

General Gameplay Improvements

 Fixed lit drop target issues

Bug Fixes

 Fixed mouse cursor not showing in main menu if user had RMB down when opening menu
 Misc drop target fixes

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.7.18
notes.notes:
New Features

 Added attract mode! Inserts, etc will blink according to their logic controllers. Inclusion in attract mode can be set in the object details panel.
 Added new shooter knob options. Choose from 4 different styles. Please see accompanying update video for more details.
 Added lit material for flippers and drop targets. Decals will not display on lit materials, for now.


General Gameplay Improvements

 Redesigned rubber bounce control method. Rubber can now be set from 0 (no bounce) to 9 (very bouncy) in the object details panel. Default for all rubber is 4.
 Fixed random logic controller event type
 Removed default drop target bank sound effect

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.7.12
notes.notes:
New Features

 Object names can now be user-set by clicking the name at the top of the details panel, changing the name, then pressing tab or enter to set it. Names will be saved when table is saved.
 Added duplication (ALT+D) of Logic Controllers
 Added rubber bounciness value for all objects with rubber
 Added new "W" style thumper cap with new cap texture
 Added thumper option to show or hide point value text on top of cap


General Gameplay Improvements

 Standard rail has been updated with control grabbers that can now be rotated for even more control and now includes ability to stretch ends indefinitely and rotate control grabbers for finer control of curves
 When adding teleporter, if there are no ball spawners, one is also added
 Added lights and LEDs to object selection panel
 Increased height of Lamp Posts to clear standard plastics etc
 Added flash/blink rate to thumpers
 Thumper light now affects thumper body as well as cap
 Updated details panel to only enable options relating to the selected component 

Bug Fixes

 Fixed playfield component friendly names

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.7.2.1
notes.notes: Small fix for solenoid power multiplier slider not working for some components.

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.7.2
notes.notes:
New Features

 Added Lamp Post light component and moved the "Inserts" component button in the Editor next to the bulb buttons and changed it to "Lamps and Inserts." The new Lamp Post is selectable from the Variant dropdown in the Edit Mode panel. Lamp Posts work the same way inserts do.
 Added enhancements to the Logic Controller's timer option.
 Added X/Y object location entry option.
 Connected drop targets to logic. Now their drop point value and completion point values, sounds and reset state are all controlled via one logic controller. The regular point value is scored when the targets drop and the completion point value when the bank is all dropped. Sounds work the same way. Drop targets and banks not connected to a logic controller will simply all drop and do nothing until reset at the beginning of the next ball. The functionality of the indicator arrow above the main drop target in the group remains the same. Check our YouTube channel for videos about how to make drop target banks.
 Added new deep cabinet for ramps (still in-dev, but you can start using it if you want to)


General Gameplay Improvements

 Made several minor performance enhancements 


Bug Fixes

Fixed scale of small left flipper 
Fixed some Edit Mode UI click-through issues with the details panels
Fixed some mouse control related issues when making selections between objects and details panel

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.6.28
notes.notes:
Notes
Your arcade room lighting may appear wonky after this update. But don't worry! All you need to do is readjust it. 

New Features

Added code to prevent updates from overwriting existing PinBuilder user files in AppData. If any game files already exist in Savegames, TableImages, UserImages, UserSounds or Documentation they will not be overwritten when Steam updates the game. Game-referenced files are found in AppData. Shipped/default files are located in the game install folders. If you would like to replace any of your existing files with the ones from the latest update, simply remove them from your AppData folder(s) prior to doing the install. If already installed, copy the requisite files from the install/content folder to the appropriate AppData one.
Added new "Show/Hide" option to main menu to allow hiding of table tiles from displaying as well as a "view hidden" option so they can be unhidden. A full deletion option will be created soon.
Added non-adjustable illumination to apron credit light and instruction cards
Added user-set "WHEN LIT" value to top of thumpers which changes according to what is set in its attached logic controller.
Added ball reset option in Play Mode for when the ball gets stuck. Pressing R will send it back to the shooter lane.
Added blank widebody image (can be found in /content/UserImages or AppData folders)
Connected kicker solenoid component to logic so it will kick only when lit (similar to SHIELD in Firepower)

General Gameplay Improvements

Rebuilt file installer. It will now only copy standard game files if they do not exist. 
Redesigned Play Mode lighting to improve visual quality and performance
Fixed blank playfield texture roughness and normal
Finished "WHEN LIT" logic code for scoring unlit/lit values
Set singular concurrency for user audio files auditioned from Cabinet Panel


Bug Fixes

Fixed top rail color not working
Fixed misc issue with rails
Resolved Last Color ("C") not working properly on slingshots
Misc other fixes


Other

Added block supports under playfield in workshop

notes.title: Hotfix v0.3.6.19.1
notes.notes:
Fixed an installation problem in which user settings files were overwritten. The installation routine has been updated so as to not overwrite any existing savegame files, including settings and tables. If you would like to do a fresh install, delete or rename your c:/Users/usrname/AppData/Local/PinBuilder/Saved folder.
 Fixed wonky issue that appeared with the rail component.

notes.title: UPDATE v0.3.6.19
notes.notes:
New Features

Cabinet Type selector and new widebody cabinet type. The selector appears in Cabinet Editing Mode
Added editor mode keys: 1, 2, 3 to easily access the Edit, Cabinet and Logic modes, respectively
Added glass hit sounds
Added colorable plastic/plexi ball guides (similar to metal ball guides)
Made top-rail posts colorable
Added hard rubber post variant to metal post (found in variant dropdown in object panel after spawning and selecting a standard metal post)
Added numeric indicators to component icons to show # of variants available


General Gameplay Improvements

Changed the Multiball Spawner to one ball instead of three and sized it to normal ball size so it can be used to check lane widths etc.
Raised height of apron to prevent balls being trapped between apron and glass
Improved wire gate bounce and spring behavior
Improved color selection/setting on several objects
Slightly lowered plunger shot power
Improved loading of table menue images to avoid blank tiles
Added slight bounce to metal
Add ball hit sounds to top rail
Lengthened fade-in time on room/shop loading


Bug Fixes

Fixed bug with round targets spawning backward and default color not saving unless changed
After spawning, plastic nut default color was not saving unless changed before saving
Set multiball spawner so its collision state matches its visibility
Fixed color bug present in apron and wood surround
Fixed issue with choosing a new table from the menu while in Logic Mode. Doing so caused Logic Mode not to work temporarily.
Fixed inability to move objects when in Logic Mode after loading of a table after having already opened one
Fixed kicker kicking out two balls after locking
Fixed kicker not kicking out after ball loss (multiball soon)


Notes
Customizable metal walls may appear slightly wonky after this update as we slightly widened the curvature of the nodes

notes.title: HOTFIX #0.3.6.12
notes.notes:
BUGFIXES

Fixed bug rendering some playfield components unselectable
Removed duplicate instance of wood surround from Play Mode
Updated apron texture so imagery for the instruction cards can be set with the same texture as the apron.

notes.title: UPDATE #0.3.6.11
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Changes to input mappings now save as they should
 Graphics settings save and load upon reload but we are still having an issue with applying settings immediately. We are working on this and a method to "Keep Changes?"
 Score displays were changing during game start with no credits
 Multiple instances of HUD to were appearing when changing menus
 Ball was hanging in serving lane at higher table angles
 Ball velocity was dropping unexpectedly 
 Ball was not making sounds when in game over
 Lane change was still working during game over
 Wood hit sound was lagging slightly
 Move button was partially obstructed, causing user input to be blocked


General Gameplay Improvements

 Fixed occlusions by invisible grabbers causing problems grabbing visible grabbers. 
 Added FPS option (Play Mode only) to menu
 Keymappings now save when changed
 Increased visibility of ball
 Playfield glass not as dark
 Increased lighting at upper playfield slightly in Play Mode
 Updated ball physics to improve roll, friction, rebound and bounce properties
 Increased playfield friction slightly
 Improved gate physics for better rebound and feel
 Added flipper rest and full extension options to Editor
 Added "ghost" flippers to edit mode to indicate full extension settings
 Removed tick sound from flipper inputs when tilted
 Reduced friction of flipper rubber 
 Added variation to mechanical sounds so they sound more like they should when glass is on or off
 Tweaked ball sounds to improve realism
 Added glass hit sounds
 Added wire hit sounds
 Added restart to background sound after each ball, so long sounds that escalate in pitch and/or tempo can reset and for post-tilt background sound restart.
 Updated rubber bump sounds
 Balls now kick out of kicker holes when tilted
 Thumpers no longer score points or make sounds when tilted
 "TILT!" now clears on new game starting
 Removed Main Menu Resume key due to issues returning to Edit Mode. Use ESC to return to Edit Mode.
 Stopped Play Mode creating new HUDs every time ESC was pressed
 Added prevention of non-alpha characters being entered into Gamesave names
 Uploaded PNG template files for cabinets and apron to public shares and the UserImages folder
 Confirmed that images in AppData folders are functioning as expected. Upon initial installation users may not see all images loaded. We are still looking into the cause of this however once reloaded the app should be displaying table images as expected.
 Made arcade playfield cover mat textures higher resolution.
 Shop light now stays visible/invisible after toggling visibility with CTRL+F
 Added groove to playfield shooter lane for more realistic behavior

notes.title: Update #0.3.6.3 Notes
notes.notes:
User file directories relocated

 Some users reported no table or room menu tiles in the main menu. To more effectively handle user files and consolidate them into a single location they were moved to C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\PinBuilder\Saved folder. Please note that the very first run of the game may not display all game or room image tiles. if not, please quit and restart the game.

Changes to Main Menu

 Aesthetic changes to the main menu were made to simplify it and make it more intuitive.
 Some non-interactable UI elements were causing the mouse cursor to disappear when clicked on.

Table Tweaks

 Few minor tweaks made to Alien Meadow and Kaiju Battle.
